### Calm, Wise, and Confident
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-21-2024.html
Passage: Esther 5:1-2
Points:
- Earthly rulers never intimidate God, who holds control over every human heart.
- Esther stood with dignity and calm assurance rather than cowering in fear.
- God moved the king to extend his golden scepter and offer her his favor.
- Esther demonstrated patience and discernment instead of rushing ahead with impulsive accusations.
- Waiting on the Lord guards believers from rash actions and surrenders control to Him.

### Approaching the King
Author: Kimberly Orr
Site: The Upper Room
URL: https://www.upperroom.org/devotionals/blog-posts/2492
Passage: Esther 5:1-3
Points:
- Esther's entrance into the throne room illustrates how to come before royalty.
- Believers should approach the sovereign Lord with intentionality, humility, and reverent boldness.
- God does not need to be persuaded to love us, since believers are already His children.
- In Jesus Christ, believers are assured an enduring place of favor before the throne of grace.
